en.name: Safe landing
en.subtitle: Teacher review
steps: Review knee bending, arm position and steadiness after landing with your teacher. Video does not measure impact force.
Place the camera to your side and keep your whole movement in view.
en.focus: Review with your teacher. No automatic technique score is assigned.

zh-Hant.name: 安全落地
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師檢視
steps: 與老師檢視落地後的屈膝、手臂位置及穩定度。影片無法測量衝擊力。
將鏡頭放在身體側面，讓整個動作保持在畫面內。
zh-Hant.focus: 與老師一同檢視，不提供自動技術評分。
